description.value: Once per day, spend every remaining point in your Vitae pool on a single thrown Graft. It resolves as a Mk IV Graft of its own type, its area doubles, and every creature in that area takes the full effect with no splash reduction. You finish the throw at 0 Vitae and drained 2 until you next rest. Everything you were carrying is in the air, and then it is in them.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Also depends on fleshmancer.butchers.json, itself underspecified (see that card's own disposition).
